name: New Style 3 — Documentary
label: New Style 3 — Documentary (Emerge X)
blurb: A premium streaming-documentary look where real archive footage carries the picture and quiet, expensive-looking scenes — maps, real headlines, photo spotlights, cut-out objects, calm cream-and-gold serif graphics — land exactly on the words.
tagline: Real footage first; quiet cream-and-gold scenes exactly on the words.
points: Real archive footage, a new shot every ~4 s
Maps, real headline pages, photo spotlights
Still one-line captions, labels in the corners
Match cut and text match cut once a video
best_for: history, business and brand stories, crime and scandal, sport history, science and space, biographies, investigations, geopolitics explainers

pacing.hook_notes: The first 60 s is the most edited stretch: a map of the first place, a dateline on the first date, a spotlight on the first public figure, an object for the product at the centre, a paper-collage moment of 7-11 s inside the first 30 s, the real headline on the first reported fact, the match cut on the first naming of the main person, the sound-up, and at least 5 labels.
pacing.body_notes: Body: scenes cover at most 42 %; at least 6 s of plain footage between scenes; per minute roughly one collage, 1-2 spotlights/objects, one graphic (one every ~45 s), 1-2 real headlines on reported facts, 3-5 labels; a map when a new place matters. Never the same scene type twice in a row.
